title: Euelthon
summary: Raleigh names Euelthon in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Euelthon, King of a gapped place, whom Cambyses constrained to acknowledge him. The place is a gap and was not filled. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter IV, §. III, sig. 403b
